title: Would — the conditionnel, and Six Lines
label: ch:fr-would
canDo: I can say what would happen with the conditionnel, and write six connected lines about a journey that end looking forward.

payoff.summary: Complete FR-W267-six-lignes: six lines to one reader: the scene in the imparfait, events in order, a reason, and a last line with j'espère, ce serait or si.
